caption:
Rockstar Games workers vote against union recognition

Workers at Rockstar Games voted overwhelmingly against union recognition. Only a quarter voted in favor of a formal deal with the studio. The IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union will continue to organize.

Reported by Engadget; IGN; Polygon; Techmeme.
